description: Single-server guarantee: every start now frees the console port first — ANY stale holder on 7777 is stopped (graceful SIGINT then forced SIGKILL, suspended ones resumed first), so exactly one server ends up running no matter how many times setup is re-run.
features: Pre-start port check kills ANY holder on 7777 (old/suspended/stale server or squatter), not just our own processes.
Holder lookup via ss, lsof, or /proc fallback (PID 1 and own PID never signalled).
Same guarantee on all start paths: setup.sh, install.py --run, and the x5agent command.
Version synced to 0.15.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
